apis.description:
Returns the paginated list of external tools for the current context.
See the get request docs for a single tool for a list of properties on an external tool.

operations.notes:
Returns the paginated list of external tools for the current context.
See the get request docs for a single tool for a list of properties on an external tool.

parameters.name: course_id
parameters.description: ID

parameters.name: search_term
parameters.description: The partial name of the tools to match and return.

parameters.name: selectable
parameters.description: If true, then only tools that are meant to be selectable are returned.

parameters.name: include_parents
parameters.description: If true, then include tools installed in all accounts above the current context

parameters.name: placement
parameters.description:
The placement type to filter by.

Return all tools at the current context as well as all tools from the parent, and filter the tools list to only those with a placement of 'editor_button'

apis.description:
Returns a sessionless launch url for an external tool.
Prefers the resource_link_lookup_uuid, but defaults to the other passed
  parameters id, url, and launch_type

NOTE: Either the resource_link_lookup_uuid, id, or url must be provided unless launch_type is assessment or module_item.

response_fields.description: The url to load to launch the external tool for the user.

apis.description: Create an external tool in the specified course/account. The created tool will be returned, see the "show" endpoint for an example. If a client ID is supplied canvas will attempt to create a context external tool using the LTI 1.3 standard. See the Placements Documentation for more information on what placements are available, the possible fields, and their accepted values.

operations.notes: Create an external tool in the specified course/account. The created tool will be returned, see the "show" endpoint for an example. If a client ID is supplied canvas will attempt to create a context external tool using the LTI 1.3 standard. See the Placements Documentation for more information on what placements are available, the possible fields, and their accepted values.

parameters.name: course_id
parameters.description: ID

parameters.name: client_id
parameters.description:
The client id is attached to the developer key.
If supplied all other parameters are unnecessary and will be ignored

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The name of the tool

parameters.name: privacy_level
parameters.description: How much user information to send to the external tool.

parameters.name: consumer_key
parameters.description: The consumer key for the external tool

parameters.name: shared_secret
parameters.description: The shared secret with the external tool

parameters.name: description
parameters.description: A description of the tool

parameters.name: url
parameters.description:
The url to match links against. Either "url" or "domain" should be set,
not both.

parameters.name: domain
parameters.description:
The domain to match links against. Either "url" or "domain" should be
set, not both.

parameters.name: icon_url
parameters.description: The url of the icon to show for this tool

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: The default text to show for this tool

parameters.name: custom_fields[field_name]
parameters.description:
Custom fields that will be sent to the tool consumer; can be used
multiple times

parameters.name: is_rce_favorite
parameters.description:
(Deprecated in favor of {api:ExternalToolsController#mark_rce_favorite Mark tool to RCE Favorites} and
{api:ExternalToolsController#unmark_rce_favorite Unmark tool from RCE Favorites})
Whether this tool should appear in a preferred location in the RCE.
This only applies to tools in root account contexts that have an editor
button placement.

parameters.name: <placement_name>[<placement_configuration_key>]
parameters.description: Set the <placement_configuration_key> value for a specific placement.

parameters.name: config_type
parameters.description:
Configuration can be passed in as Common Cartridge XML instead of using query
parameters. If this value is "by_url" or "by_xml" then an XML
configuration will be expected in either the "config_xml" or "config_url"
parameter. Note that the name parameter overrides the tool name provided
in the XML.

parameters.name: config_xml
parameters.description:
XML tool configuration, as specified in the Common Cartridge XML specification. This is
required if "config_type" is set to "by_xml"

parameters.name: config_url
parameters.description:
URL where the server can retrieve an XML tool configuration, as specified
in the Common Cartridge XML specification. This is required if "config_type" is set to
"by_url"

parameters.name: not_selectable
parameters.description:
Default: false. If set to true, and if resource_selection is set to false,
the tool won't show up in the external tool
selection UI in modules and assignments

parameters.name: oauth_compliant
parameters.description:
Default: false, if set to true LTI query params will not be copied to the
post body.

parameters.name: unified_tool_id
parameters.description: The unique identifier for the tool in LearnPlatform

apis.description:
Get a list of external tools with the course_navigation placement that have not been hidden in
course settings and whose visibility settings apply to the requesting user. These tools are the
same that appear in the course navigation.

The response format is the same as for List external tools, but with additional context_id and
context_name fields on each element in the array.

operations.notes:
Get a list of external tools with the course_navigation placement that have not been hidden in
course settings and whose visibility settings apply to the requesting user. These tools are the
same that appear in the course navigation.

The response format is the same as for List external tools, but with additional context_id and
context_name fields on each element in the array.

parameters.name: context_codes
parameters.description:
List of context_codes to retrieve visible course nav tools for (for example, +course_123+). Only
courses are presently supported.

response_fields.name: context_id
response_fields.description: The unique identifier of the associated context

response_fields.name: context_name
response_fields.description: The name of the associated context
